paragraphs.text:
Once you have covered a few miles, the woman’s eyes clear and 
she no longer wishes to be taken by the mysterious demons of 
the forest. Grateful for her rescue, she speaks easily and you 
gain many stories and myths of the North Hanninah Valley.

She is very curious about the towns of the white men and 
seems to have great knowledge of the landscape.

If you want to end your journey, accompany her to 593. If you want 
to explore more, she will find her own way to Fort McDonald; go 
to 600.
